welcome.question: What can I do for you?
starter.summarize.prompt: Summarize this text in a few clear points:
starter.email.prompt: Help me write an email to
composer.label: Your message
composer.placeholder: Ask anything, or describe a task…
speech.noVoice: No voice on this device can read {language}. Your system’s settings can add one.
history.title: Conversations
history.confirmDelete: Delete this conversation? This can’t be undone.
activity.stop.max_tokens: Cut off: the reply was too long
approval.title: Your approval is needed
approval.question: Allow this? {action}
settings.title: Settings
storage.ephemeral: Private window: nothing will be saved after you close it.
update.ready: A new version of {name} is ready.
error.auth: {brain} refused the key. Check it, or connect another brain.
error.rate_limit: {brain} is busy or your limit is reached. Wait a moment and try again.
error.cors_or_offline: Couldn’t reach {brain}. You may be offline, or the service doesn’t accept requests from this site ({origin}).
error.bad_request: {brain} didn’t accept the request. Try another version of this brain.
error.not_found: {brain} couldn’t find this version. Pick another one.
error.server: {brain} is having trouble. Try again in a moment.
error.bad_response: {brain} sent an answer that couldn’t be read. Try again.
activity.cached: reused what it had already read
files.unsupported: Can’t read this kind of file yet
files.missing: {name} is no longer on this device
capture.name: Screen capture {time}
dictation.download: Dictation on this device needs a one-time download of about {size} MB. Download it now?
dictation.denied: Allow the microphone in your browser to dictate.
error.too_long: This conversation is too long for {brain}. Start a new one, or choose a bigger brain.
dictation.nothing: Nothing was heard. Try again, a little closer to the microphone.
dictation.retry: This browser’s own dictation didn’t answer. Press again to use dictation on this device instead.
suggest.title: Suggestions
suggest.email.prompt: Draft an email based on that.
auto.name: Auto
auto.smarter.prompt: Please look at this again, more thoroughly.
auto.reason.private: you chose never to use the cloud
auto.reason.personal: kept on this device: personal content
auto.reason.unhappy: a step up after the last answer
auto.noPrivate: There is no brain on this device to use without the cloud. Add one, or allow the cloud.
offer.title: Something new
cap.files.name: Files
cap.files.offer: You can drop files on me: PDFs, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text or pictures. You can also capture your screen.
cap.made.name: Documents and spreadsheets
cap.compute.name: Calculations
cap.compute.offer: Want exact numbers? {name} can calculate with your data instead of estimating, safely, on this device.
cap.reflexes.name: Intuition
cap.reflexes.offer: Let {name} get a feel for what you need? A small helper ({size}, once) picks the right brain and suggests next steps, without sending anything anywhere.
cap.reflexes.failed: Intuition couldn’t be downloaded. Try again later.
cap.backup.name: Backup
cap.backup.offer: Your conversations live only in this browser. Keep a copy of everything?
cap.brain-local.name: A brain on this device
cap.memory.name: Memory
cap.memory.offer: Want me to remember things like this from now on? You can see and change everything I keep.
cap.projects.name: Projects
cap.projects.offer: Shall I make this a project? Its notes and files would stay separate.
cap.skills.name: Skills
cap.skills.offer: This is the third time you’ve asked for something like this. Save it as a skill, so it’s done the same way every time?
cap.routines.name: Routines
cap.routines.offer: You’ve asked for this on three different days. Make it a routine, done on its own on a schedule?
cap.python.name: Data toolkit
cap.python.offer: Python would help here: the language analysts use, in a sandbox on this device. About {size}, downloaded once.
suggest.skill.prompt: Save what you just did as a skill, so it’s done the same way next time.
suggest.routine.prompt: Make this a routine, done on a schedule that fits how often I ask for it.
suggest.ready: See a ready-made skill for this
cap.search.name: Web search
cap.search.offer: This needs a look on the web. Search when a question needs it? Answers will show their sources.
cap.browser.name: Browser
cap.browser.offer: Open web pages beside the conversation, to look at them while you talk?
cap.connections.name: Connections
cap.connections.offer: This needs one of your services. Connect it? You’ll be asked before anything is done there.
cap.live.name: Live conversation
cap.live.offer: You dictate often. Talk hands-free instead? Answers are read aloud, and you can interrupt. About {size}, once.
sources.title: Sources
cap.helpers.name: Helpers
cap.helpers.offer: This is a big task with separate parts. Hand them to helpers, who work on them at the same time?
cap.check.name: Double-check
cap.check.offer: Double-check each answer against its sources? It takes one more short request per answer.
cap.since.name: Since last time
cap.since.offer: Welcome back. Want a short brief of what’s new in your services each time you return? It only reads.
cap.names.name: Assistant names
cap.names.offer: Want to give this project’s assistant a name?
cap.find.name: Search
cap.find.offer: There’s a lot to look back on now. Search all your conversations and files in one place?

check.unsupported.one: {count} claim isn’t supported by its source
check.unsupported.other: {count} claims aren’t supported by their sources

check.fix: Correct what the sources don’t support
check.fix.prompt: Your sources don’t support these points. Check them again and correct your answer:
since.closed: Work stops while this tab is closed, so this was read just now.
